name: Choreographed 3D Transforms & Perspective
description: Orchestrates the 5 fundamental animation transforms: 3D translation (X,Y,Z), Euler 3D rotations, scale, dynamic velocity skew, and specular reflection highlights.
move: 3D perspective swoop, multi-axis tilt with specular glare, and inertial exit
adapt: Swap card graphics, branding, or replace with product UI panels. The 3D perspective matrix produces authentic physical depth.
port: Calculates translate3d, rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ, skewX, and scale smoothly mapped over the duration.
